topic: The impact of artificial intelligence on future employment
essay: AI will change jobs. Some jobs may disappear and new jobs may appear. People should learn new things. Companies should use AI carefully. This is important for the future.

topic: The impact of artificial intelligence on future employment
essay: AI is likely to change tasks within jobs before it replaces every occupation. A support worker may spend less time drafting routine replies and more time resolving unusual cases. This can raise output, but employers may also reduce entry-level hiring. Training alone cannot remove that tension: workers need time and access to new roles, and organizations must decide how to share productivity gains. The balance will depend on adoption costs, demand and institutional choices, so neither universal unemployment nor effortless prosperity is a justified prediction.
source: Hand-authored format demonstration; not independently scored; not empirical evidence

topic: Benefits and limitations of remote work
essay: Remote work removes some commuting costs and can widen access to jobs. However, a new employee may find it harder to ask informal questions or build trust through a screen. Teams can reduce this problem by making onboarding explicit and choosing meeting times carefully. A uniform policy will not suit every task, home environment or accessibility need.
source: Hand-authored format demonstration; not a held-out research benchmark

essay: A reliable bus service can make work and education reachable without a car. Frequency and safe walking connections matter as much as purchasing vehicles. Low-density areas may need a different mix of services, and construction can temporarily disrupt businesses. Cities should compare access, reliability and public cost before selecting investments.
